paite: Huan Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok, Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal dam lai in hichi ahong hi a;
heading: Abram In Lot Ahunkhia
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

paite: amau Sodom kumpipa Bera asim uhi. Gomorrah kumpipa Birsha, Admah kumpipa Sinab, Zeboiim kumpipa Semeber, Bela kumpipa leng asim uhi, huai tuh Zoar ahi.
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

paite: Hiai tengteng Siddim Phaizang ah apang uh, huai tuh Chi Tuipi ahi.
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

paite: Kum sawm-le-nih sung Kedorla-omer nuai ah ana om ua, akum sawm-le-thumna in ahelta uhi.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

paite: Akum sawm-le-lina ah Kedorla-omer leh akiang a kumpipa omte ahong ua, Asteroth-karnaim ah Rephaimte athat ua, Ham ah Zuzimte athat ua, Shaveh-kariathaim ah Emimte athat uh;
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

paite: a-omna Seir tang a El-paran gamdai zul a Horte omna tanpha in.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

paite: Akik nawn ua, Enmishpat atung ua, huai ahihleh Kadesh ahi a, Amalekte gam a mi teng leh Amorte, Hazezon-tamar a tengte leng athat nawn uhi.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

paite: Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboiim kumpipa leh Bela (huai Zoar kichi) kumpipa apawt ua, Siddim Phaizang ah amau sual ding in apangta uhi.
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

paite: Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amraphelte, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok sual ding in, Kumpipa li in kumpipa nga asual uhi.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

paite: Longnai khuk in Siddim Phaizang adim a; Sodom leh Gomorrah kumpipate ataikekna lam uah, khenkhatte huai ah akia ua, akeloute tang ah ataitou uhi.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah mite sum tengteng leh anek ding tengteng uh la in apaita uhi.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

paite: Sodom a om Abram unaupa tapa, Lot leh aneih teng toh alaksak ua, apaita uhi.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

paite: Huai a pan suakta mi khat ahong pai a, Hebru mi Abram ahilh a, amah Amor mi Mamre tosaw kiang a teng ahi. Mamre ahihleh Eshkol leh Aner unaupih ahi a; huai mite Abram toh pangkhawm ahi uh.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

paite: Abram in unaupa sal in api uh chih azaktak in, a-inn a piang, ama'n achilsiamsa mi zathum apikhia a, Dan khua pha in adelhta hi.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

paite: Zan in amau sual ding in amah leh asikhate akihawmzak ua, azou ua Hobah pha in adelh uh; Hobah bel Damaskas mallam a om ahi.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

paite: Thil tengteng alakik nawn vek a, a-unaupa Lot leh aneih tengteng ban ah midang tengteng toh, numeite leng ahon pi nawn hi.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

paite: Kedorla-omer leh akiang a om kumpipate zou a, apaikik lam in Shaveh Phaizang (huai Kumpipa Phaizang kichi) ah Abram dawn ding in Sodom kumpipa ahohsuk hi.
heading: Melkizedek In Abram Avualzawl
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

paite: Salem kumpipa Melkizedek in tanghou leh uain ahon tawi a; amah Pathian Tungnungpen siampu ahi.
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

paite: Ama'n Abram avualzawl a, "Lei leh van neipa, Pathian Tungnungpen, Abram vualzawl in om hen.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

paite: Na melmate na khut a hon pepa, Pathian Tungnungpen phat in om hen," achi hi. Abram in amah bangkim a sawm- a-khat apia hi.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

paite: Sodom kumpipa'n Abram kiang ah, "Mite hon pia inla, thilte zaw nang kineih in," achi hi.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

paite: Abram in Sodom kumpipa kiang ah, "Lei leh van neipa, TOUPA, Pathian Tungnungpen lam ah ka khut ka zakta hi.
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

paite: Khauzang khat lel leng, khedap khau khat lel leng, na neih himhim ka la kei ding, huchi lou in zaw, Abram, kei hauhsaksak ahi, na chi kha ding," achi hi.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

paite: "Tangvalte nekmang leh ka mi tonpihte tantuan kia lou zaw ka la kei ding, Aner, Eshkol leh Mamrete'n atantuan uh la uhen," achi hi.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
